decisions.reason: The Magento 2 template is cheap to keep, but it has shown no visible traction since launch and Magento's relevance for agencies is fading, so the option is losing value though it is not yet clearly worth abandoning.
The responsive template was only ever briefly mentioned and gives little evidence of value, but its low upkeep and fit with the hosting offer make keeping it slightly better than dropping it for now.
Premium support is core to the firm's agency-focused, round-the-clock service model and earns recurring revenue at little extra cost, so the option has largely proven its value.
The version management tool builds on the firm's tooling that cuts recurring operational work and had its own page, so it remains a worthwhile option, though newer platform tools could replace it.
The data processing contract tool is distant from the core offer, but GDPR compliance needs persist and keeping a web tool online costs little, so abandoning it is not yet justified.
Scalable agency hosting is the firm's flagship and strategic direction, and the missing archive pages for 2020 and 2021 give no evidence against it, so further commitment is warranted.
